digest.en: Middle East & Africa leads the board this hour with Bangladesh launches measles vaccination drive amid deadly outbreak. Global / Multilateral carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर मध्य पूर्व और अफ्रीका की अगुवाई है, नीले ड्रम में भरी हिंदू की लाश, नाले में फेंकी, बांग्लादेश में अल्पसंख्यकों की सीरियल किलिंग्स कब मुख्य खबर है। साथ ही एशिया-प्रशांत से भी घटनाक्रम सामने आया है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Bangladesh launches measles vaccination drive amid deadly outbreak
articles.summary: Health experts have attributed the crisis to disruptions in routine immunisation programmes in 2024 and 2025, when political turmoil, changes to vaccine procurement and the postponement or cancellation of vaccination campaigns left many children unprotected. Bangladesh launches measles vaccination drive amid deadly outbreak.

articles.title: 'I receive way more than I've given': The psychologist helping teenage girls through trauma others
articles.summary: As the head of the home HCSA Dayspring, Ms Valerie Wong works with teenage girls who have experienced abuse, neglect and other forms of trauma. She tells CNA TODAY why she keeps showing up – and why we should look beyond appearances when it comes to young people in distress. 'I receive way more than I've given': The psychologist helping teenage girls through trauma others.

articles.title: Don’t you know that you’re toxic? Here's how to handle a difficult colleague
articles.summary: As an employee, he stayed silent about toxic colleagues and quit when he could not handle a workplace that felt like a landmine field. But now, as a business owner, here's why Kelvin Kao acts differently in dealing with toxic behaviour. Don’t you know that you’re toxic? Here's how to handle a difficult colleague.

articles.title: Six dead after explosion destroys building in Athens
articles.summary: The blast - near some of Athens' most visited sites including the Acropolis and the Temple of Zeus - damaged nearby houses, shops and cars and sent rubble and broken glass as far as three blocks away. Six dead after explosion destroys building in Athens.

articles.title: Countries adopt global blueprint to tackle fast-evolving crime in digital age
articles.summary: Countries adopted on Saturday a new global blueprint for tackling rapidly evolving forms of crime on Saturday, as the UN’s largest gathering on crime prevention and criminal justice opened in Abu Dhabi with a call for stronger international cooperation. Countries adopt global blueprint to tackle fast-evolving crime in digital age. Countries adopted on Saturday a new global blueprint for tackling rapidly evolving forms of crime, as the UN’s largest gathering on crime prevention and criminal justice opened in Abu Dhabi with a call for stronger international cooperation.

articles.title: UN General Assembly debate Day 4
articles.summary: Small island leaders at the United Nations General Assembly on 26 September demanded climate justice, stronger ocean protection and increased solidarity. They warned that rising seas are already reshaping national borders and that distant conflicts are producing tangible impacts on their coasts. From the Caribbean to the Pacific, leaders from small island States demanded climate justice, ocean protection and greater solidarity at the UN General Assembly on Friday.

S.-China Super Intelligence (SI) Dialogue to exchange views on risks and benefits” of AI, the White House said in a fact sheet, noting that their leaders had agreed to use the term SI rather than AI. articles.title: Poland Offers Financial Incentives To US As Talks On Military Base Advance, Minister Tells RFE/RL
articles.summary: Poland is offering to pay $15,000 a year for every US soldier stationed on its territory and cover infrastructure costs as Warsaw and Washington move closer to agreeing on establishing a permanent American military base. Poland Offers Financial Incentives To US As Talks On Military Base Advance, Minister Tells RFE/RL.

articles.title: Ukrainian Soldiers Brave Russian Drones On Trek To Frontline Settlements
articles.summary: Ukrainian troops trek nearly 20 kilometers to reach Bilozerske in the embattled Donetsk region. Russian drone and aerial attacks have laid waste to the city that used to house 15,000 inhabitants. Speaking with RFE/RL, one soldier said that "everything is bad" near Dobropillia. Ukrainian Soldiers Brave Russian Drones On Trek To Frontline Settlements.

articles.title: Pomp over progress in Xi’s US summit with Trump is a win for China
articles.summary: While the US president hailed the visit as ‘great’, almost nothing of substance was achieved, which was a win for XiKey takeaways from the Trump-Xi summit in WashingtonIf the Beijing meeting between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping in May was the “stalemate summit”, the second round of talks between the presidents of the US and China this week seemed to give up entirely on the idea of breakthroughs.

articles.title: Tuvalu urges decisive global action as rising seas threaten its future
articles.summary: Climate change remains the greatest existential threat to Tuvalu, Prime Minister Feleti Teo told the UN General Assembly on Friday, warning that the pace and scale of international action are still falling far short of what vulnerable island nations need. Tuvalu urges decisive global action as rising seas threaten its future.

articles.title: West Bank demolitions accelerate, urgent support for Sudan, Haiti diplacement, AI hub to boost
articles.summary: The situation in the occupied West Bank continues to deteriorate, the UN human rights office has said, pointing to the “mass destruction” of Palestinian villages and forcible transfer of residents in Msafer Yatta, South Hebron Hills. West Bank demolitions accelerate, urgent support for Sudan, Haiti diplacement, AI hub to boost.

articles.title: Nepal PM urges climate justice after ‘Himalayan tsunami’ devastates country
articles.summary: Prime Minister Balendra Shah addressed the Nepal’s Prime Minister Balendra Shah brought a stark warning from the Himalayas to the UN General Assembly on Thursday, saying catastrophic floods that killed at least 1,400 people in his country laid bare the human cost of climate change, and the failure of the international system to protect those least responsible for it. Nepal PM urges climate justice after ‘Himalayan tsunami’ devastates country.

articles.title: Six years on from COVID-19, is the world ready for the next pandemic?
articles.summary: COVID-19 killed millions, shattered health systems and brought the global economy to a virtual standstill. World leaders are meeting Friday to review the lessons learned and cement a new approach to prevention and preparation for the next pandemic. Hopes are high that a World Health Organization-led international agreement can move forward. Six years on from COVID-19, is the world ready for the next pandemic?

articles.title: Yemen violence deepens concerns over child hunger crisis
articles.summary: Aid agencies in Yemen highlighted the growing hunger emergency sparked by renewed fighting between Houthi opposition forces and Government troops, after mobile health clinics reported that hundreds of children displaced by the violence are suffering from the most deadly form of malnutrition. Yemen violence deepens concerns over child hunger crisis.

articles.title: As Deadline Looms, Ex-US Marine Desperately Seeks Brother At Afghan Refugee Camp In Qatar
articles.summary: A former US Marine spent days in Doha trying to meet his brother at an Afghan refugee camp that will close on 30 September. The camp houses 2,000 refugees whose planned transfer to the United States was halted by a presidential executive order. The inmates face an uncertain future. A former US Marine has spent days trying to see his brother at a camp in Qatar holding Afghan refugees in limbo after plans to bring them to the United States were blocked by a presidential executive order.

articles.title: Deadly New Strikes In Russia's War On Ukraine As Spillover Concerns Mount
articles.summary: Russia kept up its pattern of relentless attacks on Kyiv, killing a 14-year-old boy and injuring seven other people in a drone strike on an apartment building in the capital on September 25, Ukrainian authorities said. Deadly New Strikes In Russia's War On Ukraine As Spillover Concerns Mount.

articles.title: What Makes Russia's New Jet-Powered Drone So Dangerous?
articles.summary: RFE/RL takes apart a Russian Geran-4 drone to uncover what makes the jet-powered unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) faster, harder to intercept, and capable of operating deep inside Ukraine -- from its turbojet engine and advanced camera to foreign-made communications and navigation components. What Makes Russia's New Jet-Powered Drone So Dangerous?

articles.title: US Pushes To Turn Armenia-Azerbaijan Transit Deal Into Investment Opportunity
articles.summary: The Trump administration is trying to turn a US-brokered opening between Armenia and Azerbaijan into something more tangible: a transport corridor linking Central Asia and the South Caucasus with Western markets -- and an investment opportunity for American companies. US Pushes To Turn Armenia-Azerbaijan Transit Deal Into Investment Opportunity.

articles.title: 100 की रफ्तार से 3 तबाही लेकर आ रहा है टाइफून 'नॉर-ईस्टर', इन इलाकों में बिजली के खंभे-पेड़ कुछ
articles.summary: अमेरिका के उत्तर-पूर्वी इलाकों में भयंकर 'नॉर-ईस्टर' तूफान का अलर्ट जारी हुआ है. इससे करीब 4 करोड़ लोगों पर खतरा मंडरा रहा है. 100 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे की रफ्तार से तेज हवाएं और भारी बारिश होने का डर है. इससे पेड़ उखड़ सकते हैं, बिजली गुल हो सकती है और निचले इलाकों में पानी भर सकता है. खतरे को देखते हुए एड शीरन का कॉन्सर्ट और 'ग्लोबल सिटीजन' जैसे बड़े इवेंट्स रद्द कर दिए गए हैं।

articles.title: पाकिस्तान में भीषण धमाका, 11 पुलिसकर्मियों की मौत और 30 घायल
articles.summary: पाकिस्तान (Pakistan) में बढ़ रहे आतंकवाद की वजह से देश में आए दिन ही धमाकों के मामले सामने आते रहते हैं। इसी तरह का एक मामला आज, शनिवार, 26 सितंबर को खैबर पख्तूनख्वा (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) प्रांत में सामने आया, जब डेरा इस्माइल खान (Dera Ismail Khan) जिले में एक पुलिस चेकपॉइंट पर एक आत्मघाती हमलावर ने धमाका कर दिया। वह विस्फोटक से लदे वाहन में था और उसने पुलिस चेकपॉइंट में इसे घुसा दिया, जिससे जोर का।

articles.title: फिर दहल उठा पाकिस्तान, भीड़ के बीच में हुआ विस्फोट, 11 लोगों की दर्दनाक मौत
articles.summary: पाकिस्तान के डेरा इस्माइल खान में एक बड़ा बम धमाका हुआ है. इसमें 11 लोगों की जान चली गई और 30 से ज्यादा लोग बुरी तरह घायल हैं. मौके पर रेस्क्यू 1122 की टीम राहत काम में जुटी है. कई घायलों की हालत बहुत नाजुक है, इसलिए मौतों की गिनती और बढ़ सकती है. ये हादसा दिखाता है कि पाकिस्तान के सीमावर्ती इलाकों में सुरक्षा व्यवस्था पूरी तरह चौपट हो चुकी है. वहां उग्रवादी हमले लगातार बढ़ रहे हैं.

articles.title: 33 स्टेशन, 39 सुरंगें और 201 पुल; ईरान ने तैयार की 730KM की चाबहार-जाहेदान रेल लाइन, काम देख चीन भी
articles.summary: Chabahar Zahedan Railway Line: ईरान ने चाबहार-जाहेदान रेल प्रोजेक्ट का निर्माण पूरा कर लिया है. करीब 730 से 735 किलोमीटर के इस नेटवर्क में 33 स्टेशन और 39 सुरंगें बनाई गई हैं. 201 पुल और करीब 2,000 जल निकासी के लिए रास्ते भी तैयार किए गए हैं. मुख्य रेल लाइन की लंबाई करीब 630 किलोमीटर है. सब लाइन को मिलाने पर यह रेल नेटवर्क करीब 735 किलोमीटर हो जाता है.
